title.en: Remove the secret key from the file "src/lib/supabase.ts" and rotate it
title.ur: File "src/lib/supabase.ts" se secret key hatayein aur use rotate karein

why.en: A Supabase secret key was found in a file of the public repository. Anyone can read it there, and the old commits keep it even after the file is changed.
why.ur: Ek Supabase secret key public repository ki file mein mili. Wahan jo bhi chahe parh sakta hai, aur file badalne ke baad bhi purane commits mein rehti hai.

steps.en: Rotate the key now: in Supabase go to API keys, create a new secret key and delete the old one.
steps.ur: Key abhi rotate karein: Supabase -> API keys mein nayi secret key banayein aur purani delete karein.

steps.en: Take the key out of the file, keep it only in an env file that is not committed, and add that file to .gitignore.
steps.ur: Key ko file se nikalein, use sirf aisi env file mein rakhein jo commit nahi hoti, aur us file ko .gitignore mein daalein.

steps.en: Run the audit again to check that the key is gone from the files.
steps.ur: Audit dobara chalayein aur dekhein ke key ab files mein nahi hai.

title.en: Add a website address to check the site too
title.ur: Site bhi check karne ke liye website ka address dein

why.en: "Certificate and security headers of the site" was not checked, because it was not provided.
why.ur: "Site ka certificate aur security headers" check nahi hua, kyunke diya nahi gaya.

steps.en: Type the public https address of your website, and confirm that you may test it.
steps.ur: Apni website ka public https address likhein, aur tasdeeq karein ke aap use test kar sakte hain.

title.en: Add a website address to check the site too
title.ur: Site bhi check karne ke liye website ka address dein

why.en: "Secret keys inside the scripts of the site" was not checked, because it was not provided.
why.ur: "Site ki scripts ke andar chhupi hui secret keys" check nahi hua, kyunke diya nahi gaya.

steps.en: Type the public https address of your website, and confirm that you may test it.
steps.ur: Apni website ka public https address likhein, aur tasdeeq karein ke aap use test kar sakte hain.

title.en: Add Supabase details to check your tables too
title.ur: Tables bhi check karne ke liye Supabase ki details dein

why.en: "Data access (can another user or a visitor reach a row?)" was not checked, because it was not provided.
why.ur: "Data access (kya doosra user ya visitor kisi row tak pahunch sakta hai?)" check nahi hua, kyunke diya nahi gaya.

steps.en: Type the project URL, the anon key and the service key of a TEST project, and confirm that it is a test project.
steps.ur: Ek TEST project ka project URL, anon key aur service key likhein, aur tasdeeq karein ke ye test project hai.
